crawl verb

Traupman 298

rēpō, rēpere

verb, third conjugation · Conjugation on Wiktionary

Other words

  • serpō, serpere, serpsī, serptum — crawl, creep, slither, of animals

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Cic. Fin. 5.42; Traupman 144; Andresian p. 28; Traupman 298 · Conjugation on Wiktionary

    Only of animals, snakes and worms and the like; rēpō is said of people too, as of a crawling baby (Lewis & Short).

Examples

  • serpere anguiculōs, nāre anaticulās, ēvolāre merulās

    little snakes crawl, ducklings swim, blackbirds fly offCic. Fin. 5.42

See also climb.
